messages:
nina: Heads-up: narrow-change window tonight 22:00 UTC. Plan: pin runtime v2.6.0 + api v2.0.0. Console is a flag flip only. Need router parity for the new batching header permutation before we freeze. @ray @maria pls run a quick staging smoke. deploy-bot will run dry-run.

deploy-bot: dry-run scheduled in 25m. Will auto-freeze pins 10m before window. /deploy preflight: no DB migrations.

ray: Staging smoke showed intermittent 502s when runtime switches kernel under burst. Snippet: ```
2026-03-23T21:12:03Z ERROR router.proxy: upstream 502 - header-order mismatch; expected [meta,flags,seq], got [flags,meta,seq]
```
Looks like kernel-level header reorder.

maria: Router parser is strict. I can ship a short-lived tolerant shim (`router.accept_permuted_headers=true`) and canary it to a pair of nodes. No client schema changes needed.

nina: Rollback plan: if 5xx >0.6% sustained 5m -> rollback runtime to v2.5.x first. If errors persist, enable router shim and reassess. If client errors continue, roll api back to v1.9.x. Exec order: runtime -> router shim -> api. @ops-oncall ok with thresholds?

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll create alert: 5xx >0.6% for 5m -> notify #incidents + page PD. Will attach runbook with quick rollback commands.

router-eng: Canarying shim to nodes r-12 and r-13 now (2/2). Watching p95, 5xx, and KV latencies. Will update in ~6m.

deploy-bot: dry-run complete, canary started (2/2). Full rollout ETA 18m after green.

ray: Canary shows stable 5xx but p95 increased ~35ms on KV hot path. No client-visible errors. If p95 >220ms for 3m mark for rollback.

nina: Locking pin window 22:00-22:30 UTC. Draft release note: "runtime v2.6.0 - batching reorder & kernel perf; api v2.0.0 - header parsing relaxed; router - optional permuted-header shim (auto-expire 1h)." Add `router.accept_permuted_headers=true` to notes.

router-eng: Shim will auto-expire 1h after rollout. Tagging rollout metadata `#perm-header-shim`. Adding telemetry probe to console path to assert header order.

maria: LGTM :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Pager on standby. Escalate per alert.

nina: Thanks team. Keep all signals in this thread; we'll follow rollback steps if thresholds hit.
